title.zh-CN: Litz 线分层建模与数值验证：完整研究报告
title.en: Litz-Wire Modeling and Numerical Verification: Comprehensive Research Report

abstract.zh-CN:
Litz 线的高频损耗取决于单股趋肤、局部邻近场、股间复电流分配、换位路径及端部约束。本文建立可复现的分层数值验证框架，区分各层实际保留的物理内容。沿途绝缘、端部并联的股线采用共同端电压和总复电流约束，并在指定线性场路模型内给出均流判据。有限长度纵向 PEEC 则独立检查轴向长度、互项与自项积分及横向离散的影响。

在 200 kHz、20 A RMS、20 ℃ 铜导体工况下，单圆线解析与独立二维校准建立了内场参考，640 股二维共端模型具有受控网格、回流和外域检查。5024 自由度纵向模型末档 Rac 为 20.012738 mΩ/轴向m，与本档等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。固定长方体外场 RT0 算例的末两次损耗变化为 0.655090% 和 0.362916%；它检验外场算子，不能作为 Litz 输运电阻。三维 A–φ、Ansys 原生三维接口及真实性能排名的未通过边界继续保留。结果支持限定模型内的数值结论，不证明实际多级或跨层 Litz 的性能优劣。
abstract.en:
High-frequency loss in Litz wire depends on strand skin effect, local proximity fields, complex current sharing, transposition paths, and terminal constraints. This study establishes a reproducible hierarchy of numerical verification in which the physical content retained by each model is stated explicitly. Individually insulated strands connected in parallel are described by a common terminal voltage and a total complex-current constraint, yielding a current-sharing criterion within a specified linear field–circuit model. Finite-length longitudinal PEEC is then examined through independent changes in axial length, mutual and self integration, and cross-sectional discretization.

For copper at 200 kHz, 20 A RMS, and 20 °C, the round-wire analytical solution and independent two-dimensional calibration establish an internal-field reference. The 640-strand common-terminal model has controlled mesh, return, and exterior-boundary checks. The final 5024-degree-of-freedom longitudinal model gives an axial resistance of 20.012738 mΩ/m, differing by 0.044582% from its equal-area Bessel reference. The final two loss changes in the fixed-cuboid imposed-field RT0 example are 0.655090% and 0.362916%; this example tests an imposed-field operator and does not measure Litz transport resistance. Unsuccessful three-dimensional A–φ validation, native three-dimensional Ansys interfaces, and unresolved realistic-geometry ranking remain explicit boundaries. These results support numerical conclusions within stated models, without establishing the superiority of actual multilevel or cross-layer Litz structures.

title.zh-CN: 智能体驱动的可复核建模与仿真：Wolfram–Ansys MCP 工作流及 Litz 案例
title.en: Agent-Driven Reviewable Modeling and Simulation: A Wolfram–Ansys MCP Workflow with Litz-Wire Cases

abstract.zh-CN: 本文提出以任务身份、保存源码和独立验收为基础的智能体建模与仿真流程，通过 Codex、Wolfram 和 Ansys MCP 将研究问题连接到可追溯的计算产物。工作流、执行适配与物理模型分别承担任务组织、软件连接及数值实现，并通过共同参数和结果接口协作。六类已有案例覆盖解析校准与 Notebook、Maxwell 原生建模求解、跨求解器比较、频率扩展、接口修复和 A–φ 失败诊断。七股共同端口比较的复电流相对 L2 差异为 0.0106814%，电阻相对差异为 0.00132823%；这些结果对应保存网格，空间与边界收敛尚待进一步检查。案例说明了协议状态、执行状态和物理验收如何共同支持研究接续。工作流、配置、适配代码、模型与运行记录共同构成可复用的研究材料。
abstract.en: This paper presents an agent-driven modeling and simulation workflow built on task identities, saved source, and independent acceptance. Codex, Wolfram, and Ansys MCP connect research questions to traceable computational artifacts. Workflows, execution adapters, and physical models organize tasks, software connections, and numerical implementations through common parameter and result interfaces. Six recorded case classes cover analytical calibration and Notebooks, native Maxwell construction and solution, cross-solver comparison, frequency extension, interface repair, and A–φ failure diagnosis. A seven-strand common-port comparison gives a relative complex-current L2 difference of 0.0106814% and a relative resistance difference of 0.00132823%. These values concern the retained meshes; spatial and boundary convergence require further examination. The cases demonstrate how protocol status, execution status, and physical acceptance jointly support continued research. Workflows, configurations, adapter code, models, and run records provide reusable research materials.

title.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 积分敏感性。

report.zh-CN: 互项阶数与自项精度各自进行单因素对照。 互项使用 q4、q6、q8，自项使用 10/8 与 12/10。比较保留同一截面及轴向长度。
report.en: Mutual order and self accuracy are compared in separate single-factor tests. Mutual settings are q4, q6, and q8; self settings are 10/8 and 12/10. Comparisons retain the same cross-section and axial length.

title.zh-CN: RT0 外场电流与损耗切面。
title.en: RT0 imposed-field current and loss sections.

report.zh-CN: 铜长方体为 1×1×2 mm，200 kHz、1 mT RMS 外场、零净输运。 (a) 单元平均损耗密度；(b) 复 RMS 电流范数。 电流由相对面通量恢复，单元平均损耗采用 RT0 重叠积分。切面位置和色标对应归档的重构定义。
report.en: The 1×1×2 mm copper cuboid is excited at 200 kHz by a 1 mT RMS field with zero net transport. (a) Cell-average loss density; (b) complex RMS current norm. Current is reconstructed from opposing face fluxes, and cell-average loss uses RT0 overlap integration. Section positions and color scales follow the archived reconstruction definitions.

report.zh-CN: 铜长方体为 1×1×2 mm，200 kHz、1 mT RMS 外场、零净输运。 箭头为固定相位的实部，色标为复 RMS 范数。 矢量采用固定比例与稀疏单元采样。单元与面通量身份在保存的重构数据中对应。
report.en: The 1×1×2 mm copper cuboid is excited at 200 kHz by a 1 mT RMS field with zero net transport. Arrows show the real part at a fixed phase; color represents the complex RMS norm.
